paper_title: Constraining dark photon parameters based on the very high energy observations of blazars
notes: Dark-photon dark matter (DPDM) kinetic-mixing limit from VHE (HEGRA) spectra of Mrk 421 and Mrk 501 via photon-dark-photon scattering, with a dense DM spike around the host SMBH. Headline curve = Fig. 4 (figure/NFW_HEGRA_2.3_4.pdf), NFW host profile with gamma_sp=(9-2gamma)/(4-gamma), R_em=4R_s, ECPL null model, Dominguez EBL. Y-axis is plotted directly as epsilon (=chi), so no chi->chi^2 conversion needed. Vector paths extracted: Mrk 501 = black solid (drawing 74), Mrk 421 = red solid (drawing 73). I report the MAIN (more stringent) Mrk 501 lower-boundary curve; Mrk 421 (drawing 73) is nearly identical and lies slightly above. Region above the curve is excluded. The near-vertical left wall at m~0.022 eV (mass threshold ~10^-2 eV where photon-DPDM scattering opens up) was dropped, leaving the lower exclusion envelope. Minimum epsilon ~2.6e-8 at m~0.06 eV; plateau ~1e-7 over m~0.03-1 eV matching the abstract (epsilon~10^-7). x-axis calibrated on decade ticks (10^-3..10^4 eV), y-axis on epsilon decade labels (10^-12..10^0). CL: paper states 95% C.L. corresponding to Delta chi^2 >= 2.71. Assumed Milky Way local density rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3; the dominant absorption is from the host-galaxy DM spike (density-dependent search, DM = dark photon itself); reported at paper-native values, no rescaling.
